dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical geometric narrowing originating from the mid-body and accelerating toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Consistent smooth curvature along both lateral margins; no localized indentations or bulges visible at the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency brownish-grey pixel clustering localized on the right lateral flank; thin linear grey marking along the posterior dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary white canvas and lateral mottling; sharp contrast transition for the posterior midline streak.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark focal point at the blowhole; faint dark-pixel linear disruption on the posterior dorsal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep central indentation at the blowhole; longitudinal raised ridge visible along the posterior dorsal midline.
